methodology: US detectors: 60 frames sampled at integer seconds, confidence .25, sizes 640 and 1280, three warmup calls.
YOLOE: 60 frames sampled at integer seconds, confidence .15, size 1280, seven prompts recorded in script; first three timings excluded.
Tracking: 600 frames at approximately 10 Hz, same clip; first five timings excluded; baseline ByteTrack and tuned configuration compared.
Timing covers predict/track call wall time, not decoding, display, audio or end-to-end event latency.
OCR recognition performed after tracking, not during the timing loop.
One unlabeled clip: counts are predictions or candidate tracks, not recall, precision or unique correctly recognized signs.
Manual crop review found confusion between stop and do-not-enter, school and bicycle/pedestrian signs, speed40 versus35/45, and commercial signs counted as traffic signs.
Native OCR full-frame test produced no text; 22 selected crops yielded usable Pleasant Hill Rd and 40, with many blanks and some incorrect text.
Tuned tracker produced18 tracks with >=3 hits, including business signs and possible fragments; this is not18 validated traffic signs.

recommendation.architecture: Native frames -> local broad sign proposals -> tuned tracking and best raw crops -> OCR and verified sign recognition -> catalog events -> cached audio; optional asynchronous VLM for unresolved candidates.
recommendation.initial_detector: YOLOE-26s at1280 using MPS, proposed10Hz service rate
recommendation.tracker: ByteTrack tuned baseline, with further annotated validation needed
recommendation.ocr: Apple Vision for current Mac; PP-OCRv5 candidate for portable deployment, not benchmarked here
recommendation.status: Research prototype only. Existing app not switched. No full end-to-end latency/accuracy validation completed.
